questions.question: When God had Moses count the Kohathite Levites for work at the Tent of Meeting, which men were counted?

answers.text: Men from thirty to fifty years old
Men from twenty to sixty years old
Men twenty years old or more

questions.question: God told the Kohathite Levites they could touch the holy objects of the Tent of Meeting as long as they were careful. True or false?
When Israel's camp moved, what did the Gershonite Levites carry for the Tent of Meeting?
Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, oversaw the oil, incense and grain offering. What else was he put over?

answers.text: The entire tabernacle and everything in it
The training of the men for battle
The food and water for the whole camp
